test_name: Stun Lock overheat fails in left arm socket - d442db34-7119-4b5c-83e5-398cb35145c8
summary: Root cause found, but no code was changed. Stun Lock only overheats an enemy when the hit that completes its stun bar comes from the arm Stun Lock is on. GameEntity.AddStunDamage (GameEntity.cs:870) credits the whole stun to that last hit only, and Stun Lock's DamageModifier (DamageModifier.cs:64) converts stun to overheat only when that source is under its own arm. In the editor, with Stun Lock in the left arm socket: when the left arm completed the bar, every case overheated (Jack body punches, Jack head via a Focused Blaster shockwave, Junkdog punches). When a Junkdog was hit twice by the left arm and once by the right, and the right-arm hit completed the bar, it was stunned but not overheated. Knocked-back bots also take stun from crashing into props (CrashBehaviour, e.g. Car 1 - Red), so in normal play the last bit of stun is often not from the Stun Lock arm. A Jack face hit adds about 500 stun, which fills the bar in one hit, so it always works. I did not pick a fix because it needs a design decision: which stuns should count for Stun Lock, and in what order stun-duration items like Over Stun should apply. Either way it changes core stun code that every entity shares.
